verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies to Microsoft Authenticator. Probes found no such resource: llms.txt returned HTTP 404, the markdown version of the FAQ returned HTTP 404, and all OpenAPI candidate paths returned 404. None of the support docs mention agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
